major.name: The Dawnbound Concord
major.description: A concord of kingdoms and holy orders united beneath the dawn, sworn to hold back whatever survived the Sundering.

major.name: The Duskward Pact
major.description: A pact of exiles, opportunists, and old powers who found common cause in the dusk — and common enemies in the Concord.

joinable.name: Silverwatch
joinable.description: A disciplined order of sentinels standing watch over Elysium's borders, open to any who can prove their steel.

joinable.name: The Wayfarer's Guild
joinable.description: A guild of scouts, traders, and pathfinders who chart the roads between danger and opportunity.

joinable.name: The Ashen Circle
joinable.description: A secretive circle devoted to the ember-magic left behind by the Sundering, walking a line between ritual and heresy.

joinable.name: The Cartographer's League
joinable.description: A league of surveyors and mapmakers racing to chart Elysium's unclaimed regions before rival powers do.

reputationNote: Actions across the world raise or lower your standing with each faction, from Hostile to Exalted. Higher standing unlocks unique quests, gear, and dialogue.
allianceNote: Factions are interconnected. Aiding Silverwatch may raise suspicion with the Ashen Circle, while standing with the Dawnbound Concord can open doors — or close them — with the Duskward Pact.
